views.name: wallet_reconciliation
views.definition:
SELECT w.id AS wallet_id,
    w.user_id,
    w.balance,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN t.type = ANY (ARRAY['deposit'::text, 'refund'::text, 'referral_credit'::text, 'auto_fund'::text, 'gift_received'::text, 'admin_credit'::text]) THEN t.amount
            WHEN t.type = ANY (ARRAY['topup_debit'::text, 'welcome_home_debit'::text, 'plan_fee_debit'::text, 'esim_purchase_debit'::text, 'call_debit'::text, 'voucher_purchase_debit'::text, 'gift_sent'::text, 'refund_payout'::text, 'admin_debit'::text]) THEN - t.amount
            ELSE 0.00
        END), 0.00) AS ledger_sum,
    w.balance - COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN t.type = ANY (ARRAY['deposit'::text, 'refund'::text, 'referral_credit'::text, 'auto_fund'::text, 'gift_received'::text, 'admin_credit'::text]) THEN t.amount
            WHEN t.type = ANY (ARRAY['topup_debit'::text, 'welcome_home_debit'::text, 'plan_fee_debit'::text, 'esim_purchase_debit'::text, 'call_debit'::text, 'voucher_purchase_debit'::text, 'gift_sent'::text, 'refund_payout'::text, 'admin_debit'::text]) THEN - t.amount
            ELSE 0.00
        END), 0.00) AS drift
   FROM wallets w
     LEFT JOIN wallet_transactions t ON t.wallet_id = w.id
  GROUP BY w.id, w.user_id, w.balance;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_refund_requests(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, user_id uuid, user_email text, amount numeric, currency text, reason text, status text, hold_id uuid, items jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone, processed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_admin();

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.user_id,
    p.email::text AS user_email,
    r.amount,
    r.currency,
    r.reason,
    r.status,
    r.hold_id,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', i.id,
          'lot_id', i.lot_id,
          'capture_id', i.original_capture_id,
          'amount', i.amount,
          'paypal_refund_id', i.paypal_refund_id,
          'status', i.status
        ))
        FROM public.wallet_refund_items i
        WHERE i.refund_request_id = r.id
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS items,
    r.created_at,
    r.processed_at
  FROM public.wallet_refund_requests r
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = r.user_id
  WHERE (p_status IS NULL OR r.status = p_status)
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_return_trip_packages_for_line(p_sim_line_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, country_id uuid, carrier_id uuid, carrier_name text, package_type text, title text, description text, data_allowance_mb integer, duration_days integer, is_unlimited boolean, supplier_cost_usd numeric, retail_price_usd numeric, effective_price_usd numeric, app_fee_usd numeric, discount_usd numeric, ussd_recharge_code text, activation_instructions text, badge_label text, account_tier text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_line_country_id UUID;
  v_line_carrier_id UUID;
  v_tier            TEXT := 'free';
  v_discount_rate   NUMERIC := 0.00;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve line country and carrier
  SELECT sl.country_id, sl.carrier_id INTO v_line_country_id, v_line_carrier_id
  FROM public.sim_lines sl
  WHERE sl.id = p_sim_line_id;

  IF v_line_country_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  v_tier := public.resolve_account_commerce_benefit(p_user_id);
  IF v_tier IS NULL THEN
    v_tier := 'free';
  END IF;

  IF v_tier = 'premium' THEN
    v_discount_rate := 1.00;
  ELSIF v_tier = 'standard' THEN
    v_discount_rate := 0.50;
  ELSE
    v_discount_rate := 0.00;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    pkg.id,
    pkg.country_id,
    pkg.carrier_id,
    c.name AS carrier_name,
    pkg.package_type,
    pkg.title,
    pkg.description,
    pkg.data_allowance_mb,
    pkg.duration_days,
    pkg.is_unlimited,
    pkg.supplier_cost_usd,
    pkg.retail_price_usd,
    round(
      pkg.supplier_cost_usd + ((pkg.retail_price_usd - pkg.supplier_cost_usd) * (1.00 - v_discount_rate)),
      2
    ) AS effective_price_usd,
    round((pkg.retail_price_usd - pkg.supplier_cost_usd) * (1.00 - v_discount_rate), 2) AS app_fee_usd,
    round((pkg.retail_price_usd - pkg.supplier_cost_usd) * v_discount_rate, 2) AS discount_usd,
    pkg.ussd_recharge_code,
    pkg.activation_instructions,
    pkg.badge_label,
    v_tier AS account_tier
  FROM public.return_trip_packages pkg
  LEFT JOIN public.carriers c ON c.id = pkg.carrier_id
  WHERE pkg.country_id = v_line_country_id
    AND pkg.is_active = true
  ORDER BY 
    CASE 
      WHEN pkg.package_type = 'esim' THEN 0
      WHEN v_line_carrier_id IS NOT NULL AND pkg.carrier_id = v_line_carrier_id THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END,
    effective_price_usd ASC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_calling_rates(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, country_code text, country_name text, phone_prefix text, destination_type text, cost_per_minute_usd numeric, base_rate_per_minute_usd numeric, effective_rate_per_minute_usd numeric, connection_fee_usd numeric, billing_increment_seconds integer, account_tier text, is_active boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_tier TEXT;
BEGIN
  v_tier := public.resolve_account_commerce_benefit(p_user_id);
  
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.country_code,
    r.country_name,
    r.phone_prefix,
    r.destination_type,
    r.cost_per_minute_usd,
    r.rate_per_minute_usd AS base_rate_per_minute_usd,
    round(
      CASE 
        WHEN r.cost_per_minute_usd IS NOT NULL AND r.cost_per_minute_usd > 0 THEN
          r.cost_per_minute_usd + COALESCE(
            public.resolve_app_fee('intelcallfee', v_tier, r.cost_per_minute_usd),
            CASE v_tier
              WHEN 'premium'  THEN round(r.cost_per_minute_usd * 0.05, 4)
              WHEN 'standard' THEN round(r.cost_per_minute_usd * 0.10, 4)
              ELSE round(r.cost_per_minute_usd * 0.15, 4)
            END
          )
        ELSE r.rate_per_minute_usd
      END,
      4
    ) AS effective_rate_per_minute_usd,
    0.00::NUMERIC AS connection_fee_usd, -- Strictly $0 connection fee per C12
    r.billing_increment_seconds,
    v_tier AS account_tier,
    r.is_active
  FROM public.call_rates r
  WHERE r.is_active = true
  ORDER BY r.country_name;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reap_stuck_executions(p_stuck_after_minutes integer DEFAULT 10, p_max_retries integer DEFAULT 3)
 RETURNS TABLE(requeued integer, dead_lettered integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_requeued integer := 0;
  v_dead integer := 0;
  v_in_flight_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Identify stuck processing executions
  -- Distinguish between safe-to-requeue (pre-submission) and in-flight/ambiguous (post-submission)
  WITH stuck_all AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.reaper_retries, COALESCE(t.pre_processing_status, 'pending') AS back_to,
           t.reloadly_transaction_id,
           (COALESCE(h.carrier_in_flight, false) OR COALESCE(t.carrier_in_flight, false)) AS carrier_in_flight
    FROM public.topup_executions t
    LEFT JOIN public.wallet_holds h ON h.id = t.wallet_hold_id
    WHERE t.status = 'processing'
      AND COALESCE(t.processing_since, t.created_at) < now() - make_interval(mins => p_stuck_after_minutes)
    FOR UPDATE OF t SKIP LOCKED
  ),
  -- In-flight / ambiguous submissions: MUST NOT be requeued to pending (F06 double-purchase prevention)
  in_flight_flagged AS (
    UPDATE public.topup_executions t
    SET status = 'failed',
        carrier_in_flight = true,
        failure_reason = 'Stuck in processing with in-flight carrier submission. Dead-lettered for manual reconciliation to prevent duplicate purchase.',
        completed_at = now()
    FROM stuck_all s
    WHERE t.id = s.id
      AND (s.reloadly_transaction_id IS NOT NULL OR s.carrier_in_flight)
    RETURNING t.id
  ),
  -- Dead-letter pre-submission executions that have exhausted retries
  dead AS (
    UPDATE public.topup_executions t
    SET status = 'failed',
        failure_reason = 'Dead-lettered by reaper: repeatedly stuck in processing before provider submission (worker crash?)',
        completed_at = now()
    FROM stuck_all s
    WHERE t.id = s.id
      AND s.reloadly_transaction_id IS NULL
      AND NOT s.carrier_in_flight
      AND s.reaper_retries >= p_max_retries
    RETURNING t.id
  ),
  -- Safe to requeue: pre-submission executions with retries remaining
  requeue AS (
    UPDATE public.topup_executions t
    SET status = s.back_to,
        reaper_retries = t.reaper_retries + 1,
        processing_since = NULL
    FROM stuck_all s
    WHERE t.id = s.id
      AND s.reloadly_transaction_id IS NULL
      AND NOT s.carrier_in_flight
      AND s.reaper_retries < p_max_retries
    RETURNING t.id
  )
  SELECT 
    (SELECT count(*) FROM requeue),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM dead) + (SELECT count(*) FROM in_flight_flagged),
    (SELECT count(*) FROM in_flight_flagged)
  INTO v_requeued, v_dead, v_in_flight_count;

  IF v_in_flight_count > 0 THEN
    INSERT INTO public.system_alerts (kind, message, details)
    VALUES (
      'in_flight_execution_stuck',
      v_in_flight_count || ' execution(s) were stuck in processing with in-flight submissions and dead-lettered to prevent duplicate purchases.',
      jsonb_build_object('in_flight_count', v_in_flight_count, 'stuck_after_minutes', p_stuck_after_minutes)
    );
  END IF;

  IF (v_dead - v_in_flight_count) > 0 THEN
    INSERT INTO public.system_alerts (kind, message, details)
    VALUES (
      'execution_dead_lettered',
      (v_dead - v_in_flight_count) || ' execution(s) dead-lettered after repeatedly getting stuck in processing.',
      jsonb_build_object('dead_lettered', v_dead - v_in_flight_count, 'requeued', v_requeued)
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_requeued, v_dead;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refill_interval_days(p_inactivity_limit_days integer, p_override integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_override IS NOT NULL AND p_override > 0 THEN LEAST(365, p_override)
    WHEN p_inactivity_limit_days IS NULL OR p_inactivity_limit_days < 1 THEN NULL
    ELSE GREATEST(1, LEAST(365,
      p_inactivity_limit_days - GREATEST(7, ceil(p_inactivity_limit_days * 0.15)::integer)))
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_fn_cancel_executions_on_schedule_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- If the parent sim_line is already deleted or being deleted, topup_executions
  -- will be cascade-deleted automatically; do not trigger cancellation cascades.
  IF OLD.sim_line_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sim_lines WHERE id = OLD.sim_line_id
  ) THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = 'cancelled',
      completed_at = now()
  WHERE scheduled_topup_id = OLD.id
    AND status IN ('pending', 'pending_payment');
  RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_fn_resume_awaiting_funds()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.type IN ('credit', 'deposit', 'refund', 'gift_received', 'referral_credit', 'manual_credit') AND NEW.amount > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.topup_executions
    SET status = 'pending',
        execution_time = NOW(),
        failure_reason = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id
      AND status = 'awaiting_funds';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_fn_refresh_alert_clocks_on_rule()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_line record;
BEGIN
  FOR v_line IN SELECT id FROM public.sim_lines
    WHERE carrier_id=NEW.carrier_id AND status='active'
  LOOP
    PERFORM public.calculate_sim_line_alert_clock(v_line.id);
  END LOOP;
  UPDATE public.notification_dispatch_jobs j
  SET state='canceled', last_error='Carrier rule changed before dispatch',
      updated_at=now()
  FROM public.notifications n
  JOIN public.sim_line_alert_clock_states cs ON cs.sim_line_id=n.sim_line_id
  WHERE j.notification_id=n.id AND j.state='pending'
    AND n.event_type='line_deactivation_imminent'
    AND cs.carrier_id=NEW.carrier_id
    AND n.source_event_key IS DISTINCT FROM
      ('deactivation_48h:' || cs.sim_line_id || ':' || cs.alert_cycle_token);
  RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_fn_sync_custom_refill_queue()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Only process custom and mini automated refills; ignore reminders (notify)
  IF NEW.schedule_type NOT IN ('refill_custom', 'refill_mini') THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- 1. No-op check: if nothing changed at all, exit immediately
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
     AND NEW.amount IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount
     AND NEW.currency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.currency
     AND NEW.next_execution_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.next_execution_at
     AND NEW.is_active IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_active
     AND NEW.offer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.offer_id
     AND NEW.offer_value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.offer_value
     AND NEW.base_cost_usd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.base_cost_usd
     AND NEW.app_fee_usd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.app_fee_usd
     AND NEW.target_local_value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_local_value
     AND NEW.target_local_currency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_local_currency
     AND NEW.max_authorized_usd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.max_authorized_usd
     AND NEW.engine_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.engine_version
     AND NEW.intent_kind IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.intent_kind
     AND NEW.preferred_provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.preferred_provider THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- 2. Cap-only update: if ONLY max_authorized_usd changed (e.g. from approve_refill_execution),
  -- update pending executions in-place without cancelling or rescheduling them.
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
     AND NEW.amount IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount
     AND NEW.currency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.currency
     AND NEW.next_execution_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.next_execution_at
     AND NEW.is_active IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_active
     AND NEW.offer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.offer_id
     AND NEW.offer_value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.offer_value
     AND NEW.base_cost_usd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.base_cost_usd
     AND NEW.app_fee_usd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.app_fee_usd
     AND NEW.target_local_value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_local_value
     AND NEW.target_local_currency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_local_currency
     AND NEW.engine_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.engine_version
     AND NEW.intent_kind IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.intent_kind
     AND NEW.preferred_provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.preferred_provider
     AND NEW.max_authorized_usd IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.max_authorized_usd THEN
    UPDATE public.topup_executions
    SET max_authorized_usd = NEW.max_authorized_usd,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE scheduled_topup_id = NEW.id
      AND status IN ('pending', 'pending_payment', 'awaiting_approval', 'awaiting_funds');
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(NEW.is_active, false) THEN
    -- Check if identical pending execution already exists with matching cap, pricing, and intent
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.topup_executions t
      WHERE t.scheduled_topup_id = NEW.id
        AND t.status = 'pending'
        AND t.execution_time = NEW.next_execution_at
        AND t.amount = NEW.amount
        AND t.offer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.offer_id
        AND t.offer_value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.offer_value
        AND t.base_cost_usd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.base_cost_usd
        AND t.target_local_value IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.target_local_value
        AND t.target_local_currency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.target_local_currency
        AND t.max_authorized_usd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(NEW.max_authorized_usd, NEW.amount)
        AND t.api_provider IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.preferred_provider
        AND t.engine_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(NEW.engine_version, 2)
        AND t.intent_kind IS NOT DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(NEW.intent_kind, 'exact_airtime')
    ) THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- Cancel existing future unsubmitted executions (preserve any execution currently due or approved for now)
    UPDATE public.topup_executions
    SET status = 'cancelled', completed_at = now()
    WHERE scheduled_topup_id = NEW.id
      AND status IN ('pending', 'pending_payment', 'awaiting_approval', 'awaiting_funds')
      AND execution_time > now();

    -- Only insert a new execution if one for next_execution_at does not already exist
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.topup_executions t
      WHERE t.scheduled_topup_id = NEW.id
        AND t.status = 'pending'
        AND t.execution_time = NEW.next_execution_at
    ) THEN
      INSERT INTO public.topup_executions (
        sim_line_id, user_id, amount, base_cost_usd, app_fee_usd, currency, status,
        execution_type, execution_time, offer_id, offer_value,
        payment_gateway_code, scheduled_topup_id, api_provider,
        target_local_value, target_local_currency, max_authorized_usd,
        engine_version, intent_kind, attempted_providers, carrier_in_flight
      ) VALUES (
        NEW.sim_line_id, NEW.user_id, NEW.amount, NEW.base_cost_usd, NEW.app_fee_usd,
        COALESCE(NEW.currency, 'USD'), 'pending',
        NEW.schedule_type, NEW.next_execution_at, NEW.offer_id, NEW.offer_value,
        'wallet', NEW.id, NEW.preferred_provider,
        NEW.target_local_value, NEW.target_local_currency, COALESCE(NEW.max_authorized_usd, NEW.amount),
        COALESCE(NEW.engine_version, 2), COALESCE(NEW.intent_kind, 'exact_airtime'),
        ARRAY[]::text[], FALSE
      );
    END IF;
  ELSE
    -- Schedule paused or deactivated: cancel unsubmitted executions across all waiting states
    UPDATE public.topup_executions
    SET status = 'cancelled', completed_at = now()
    WHERE scheduled_topup_id = NEW.id
      AND status IN ('pending', 'pending_payment', 'awaiting_approval', 'awaiting_funds');
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

BEGIN
  IF NEW.execution_type = 'refill_instant' AND NEW.retry_of IS NULL THEN

        AND execution_type = 'refill_instant'
        AND created_at > (clock_timestamp() - INTERVAL '10 seconds')
        AND id <> NEW.id

        AND retry_of IS NULL
    ) THEN

omitted_triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_sim_line_last_topup_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_freq INTEGER;
    v_mini_freq INTEGER;
BEGIN
    IF NEW.status = 'success' AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'success') THEN
        -- 1. Update sim_lines last_topup_at
        UPDATE public.sim_lines
        SET last_topup_at = COALESCE(NEW.completed_at, now()),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = NEW.sim_line_id;
        
        -- 2. Advance parent schedule (trg_fn_sync_custom_refill_queue creates the next clean pending occurrence)
        IF NEW.execution_type IN ('refill_custom', 'refill_mini') AND NEW.scheduled_topup_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            SELECT frequency_days INTO v_freq 
            FROM public.scheduled_topups 
            WHERE id = NEW.scheduled_topup_id 
            AND is_active = true;
            
            IF v_freq IS NOT NULL AND v_freq > 0 THEN
                UPDATE public.scheduled_topups
                SET next_execution_at = COALESCE(NEW.completed_at, now()) + (v_freq || ' days')::interval,
                    last_execution_at = COALESCE(NEW.completed_at, now()),
                    updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = NEW.scheduled_topup_id;
            END IF;
        END IF;

        -- 3. Cross-Flow Protection Coordination:
        -- If this recharge was a custom refill, instant refill, or manual topup,
        -- it successfully extended line validity. If this line has an active refill_mini
        -- schedule, push its next_execution_at out by its frequency window so the customer
        -- is not prematurely billed for an unneeded mini keep-alive refill.
        IF NEW.execution_type IN ('refill_custom', 'refill_instant', 'manual') OR NEW.execution_type IS NULL THEN
            SELECT frequency_days INTO v_mini_freq
            FROM public.scheduled_topups
            WHERE sim_line_id = NEW.sim_line_id
              AND schedule_type = 'refill_mini'
              AND is_active = true
            LIMIT 1;

            IF v_mini_freq IS NOT NULL AND v_mini_freq > 0 THEN
                UPDATE public.scheduled_topups
                SET next_execution_at = COALESCE(NEW.completed_at, now()) + (v_mini_freq || ' days')::interval,
                    updated_at = now()
                WHERE sim_line_id = NEW.sim_line_id
                  AND schedule_type = 'refill_mini'
                  AND is_active = true;
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_fn_cancel_executions_on_schedule_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- If the parent sim_line is already deleted or being deleted, topup_executions
  -- will be cascade-deleted automatically; do not trigger cancellation cascades.
  IF OLD.sim_line_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sim_lines WHERE id = OLD.sim_line_id
  ) THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = 'cancelled',
      completed_at = now()
  WHERE scheduled_topup_id = OLD.id
    AND status IN ('pending', 'pending_payment');
  RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$

BEGIN
  IF NEW.type IN ('credit', 'deposit', 'refund', 'gift_received', 'referral_credit', 'manual_credit') AND NEW.amount > 0 THEN

    SET status = 'pending',
        execution_time = NOW(),

      AND status = 'awaiting_funds';

  RETURN NEW;
END;
